language: JavaScript (Node.js 24) checks over compose.yaml, a Dockerfile, a GitHub Actions workflow and a YAML design worksheet, plus behaviour runs of the FastAPI service (Python, against an in-process stand-in api) and of the workflow's secret-using steps (bash, with made-up secrets and a stand-in docker)

prerequisites.version: 3.2 or later (on Windows, the bash that comes with Git for Windows, found next to git; not yet run on Windows)
prerequisites.check: bash --version (on Windows: git --exec-path shows where Git for Windows is installed)

failingTests: the workflow runs on pushes and pull requests
the test job checks out the repository before it runs the tests
the build job runs only after the test job succeeds
the image is built from the reviews folder and pushed only outside pull requests
every action is pinned to a full commit SHA
the registry login takes both credentials from repository secrets, never literals
no step prints a secret to the run log
a permissions block gives GITHUB_TOKEN least access
compose.yaml adds the reviews service built from ./reviews
reviews gets its own postgres:18 database with its own named volume
reviews DATABASE_URL names its own database service, port and database, with its own password from .env
reviews waits for its healthy database, which has a pg_isready healthcheck
reviews reaches the shop api by its service name through API_BASE_URL
reviews publishes container port 8000 and every added port binds to 127.0.0.1
the monolith, microservices and database-per-service questions match the brief
each dataset gets the store its access pattern asks for
the three store types are contrasted on schema, querying and consistency
the gateway and discovery questions match the brief
the listen-address and timeout questions match the service pages
the image reference and registry questions match the reading
the secrets-in-logs questions match the secrets page
the pipeline, Kubernetes and release-policy questions match the taught distinctions
reviews Dockerfile starts the server the way the adding-FastAPI page says an image should
the outgoing api call sets explicit connect and read timeouts
the outgoing api call forwards the caller's token, and a request without one is refused
a timed-out or refused call becomes a clear gateway error response

cleanup.notes: Delete tests/node_modules (created by npm ci), .venv (the lab's Python environment, created by npm run setup) and starter/.env (your disposable local password file). To redo the lab, restore the edited starter files from version control or a fresh copy of the bundle. The lab creates no database, image, container, workflow run or volume: nothing runs a container engine or a pipeline. Tests 24-26 run the reviews service in-process with the .venv Python, and tests 6-7 run workflow steps with bash in a temporary folder that is removed afterwards.
